note: Cocristalli di ivabradine cloridrato (IVA HCl) con acido (S)- e (R)-mandelico (IClSM, IClRM) e solvato con etanolo (IClEt): screening, riproduzione per sospensione e LAG, formazione in situ per granulazione con etanolo (non con acqua) in presenza di lattosio, test di stress sulle polveri (Tabella 5: II, γ, cocristallo a 80 °C, 0/75% RH, 100% RH) e stabilita' di miscele di formulazione A-J a 80 °C per 72 h. Non estratti: i test di stabilita' a lungo termine di IClSM e della forma δd a 25 °C/60% RH e 40 °C/75% RH dopo 2 settimane, 1 e 3 mesi (esiti solo in Table S1, supplementare); le impurezze chimiche (Tabella 5, UPLC; stabilita' chimica delle miscele; pH e acqua delle miscele); la conversione di II in γ citata nell'introduzione «during the stability treatment (this part is not included in the paper)» (gia' coperta dai test di stress); le forme di brevetto (α, βd, γd, δ, ε, ζ, δd1, δd2, ...) senza condizioni; la prova DVS e le analisi IR/Raman/ssNMR delle Figure S1-S15. condizioni.rapporto_solido_solvente: 100 mg of API and co-former in equimolar ratio in 2 mL

citazioni: Hits obtained during the screen were reproduced by two co-crystallization techniques: by slurrying (100 mg of API and co-former in equimolar ratio) in 2 mL of acetone, dioxane, DMSO, ethanol, ethyl acetate, and methanol (slurried for 48 h), and liquid-assisted grinding (LAG, same amount as for slurrying) with 0.2 mL of ethanol, ethyl acetate, and acetone (ground in a mortar and pestle for 10 min).
While IClSM was reproduced by both LAG and slurrying in all solvents, co-crystal IClRM was reproduced by both methods, however, in a lower number of solvents.
IClSM was always physically pure, while IClRM was often contaminated by input components ivabradine hydrochloride and (R)-mandelic acid.

citazioni: Mixtures of IVA HCl with an excess of racemic mandelic acid (100 mg of the mixture in 1:2 molar ratio) were slurried for two weeks (in 1 mL of ethanol and ethyl acetate) and the resulting solids were identified using XRPD.

Additionally, the maturation experiment, where ivabradine hydrochloride was exposed to the excess of racemic mandelic acid, suggested that IClSM was preferred over IClRM, as it was the prevalent resulting solid form.

citazioni: Stoichiometric amounts of IVA HCl and (S)-mandelic acid with excess of lactose monohydrate was mixed in a beaker or vial with spatula.
Using a micropipette, ethanol (EtOH) or water (WA) was added as the granulation liquid.

On the other hand, formation of co-crystal was observed when the mixture was granulated with ethanol and the co-crystal was identified by both XRPD (see Figures S17–19 in Supplementary Material) and ssNMR (see Figure 4).
Thus, ssNMR provided clear evidence of the complete conversion of hydrochloride salt into the co-crystal.
IClSM co-crystal proved to be able to form, even when its components were diluted by excess of excipients.

The initial experiments in small scale in the vial were successfully scaled-up in our own devised small scale high-shear granulator (see Figure S16 in the Supplementary Material) with, approximately, a 5 g load and even in a beaker with a load of approximately 12 g.

citazioni: Both co-crystals showed low hygroscopicity and distinct melting temperature, comparable with polymorphic form γ, which was identiﬁed in the drug product of the originator.
Investigations were performed in a temperature range of 50−200 ◦C with a heating rate of 10 ◦C/min. The temperatures speciﬁed in relation to DSC analyses are the onset temperatures of peaks.
Moreover, co-crystal IClSM exhibited a higher melting point and slightly higher density.
eventi.note: La temperatura di fusione (onset) sta nelle Figure S3 (supplementare); il testo dice solo «distinct melting temperature» e che IClSM ha un punto di fusione piu' alto di IClRM. DSC in padelle di alluminio coperte, flusso di azoto, 50-200 °C.

citazioni: Equimolar mixtures of API (20 mg) and a co-former were placed in 50-mL round-bottomed ﬂasks, dissolved in ethanol at ambient temperature, and left until crystalline material was formed. The resulting solids were then analyzed by X-ray powder diffraction (XRPD).

The co-crystal screening of ivabradine hydrochloride (IVA HCl) was conducted with 28 coformers: adipic acid, aminosalicylic acid, ascorbic acid, benzenesulfonic acid, benzoic acid, camphoric acid, cinnamic acid, citric acid, fumaric acid, gentisic acid, glutaric acid, hippuric acid, isonicotinamide, lysine, maleic acid, malic acid, malonic acid, (S)-mandelic acid, (R)-mandelic acid, nicotinamide, nicotinic acid, oxalic acid (dihydrate), pamoic acid, saccharin, salicylic acid, succinic acid, tartaric acid, and vanillin.

We performed the co-crystal screening of ivabradine hydrochloride; the resulting solids were measured by XRPD and two unique powder patterns (differing from the patterns of input components) were identiﬁed.
We conducted a co-crystal screen, from which two hits were identiﬁed: with (S)-mandelic and (R)-mandelic acid.
preparazioni.note: Screening di cocristalli con 28 coformeri: i due hit sono IClSM e IClRM. Il modo di evaporazione non e' detto («left until crystalline material was formed»).

The co-crystal screening of ivabradine hydrochloride (IVA HCl) was conducted with 28 coformers: adipic acid, aminosalicylic acid, ascorbic acid, benzenesulfonic acid, benzoic acid, camphoric acid, cinnamic acid, citric acid, fumaric acid, gentisic acid, glutaric acid, hippuric acid, isonicotinamide, lysine, maleic acid, malic acid, malonic acid, (S)-mandelic acid, (R)-mandelic acid, nicotinamide, nicotinic acid, oxalic acid (dihydrate), pamoic acid, saccharin, salicylic acid, succinic acid, tartaric acid, and vanillin.

We performed the co-crystal screening of ivabradine hydrochloride; the resulting solids were measured by XRPD and two unique powder patterns (differing from the patterns of input components) were identiﬁed.
We conducted a co-crystal screen, from which two hits were identiﬁed: with (S)-mandelic and (R)-mandelic acid.
preparazioni.note: Gli altri 26 coformeri dello screening non danno un cocristallo: l'articolo identifica solo due hit («two hits were identified»; «two unique powder patterns ... were identified»). Nessuna frase dice a parte che gli altri non hanno dato cocristalli.
